# --description--

To comment out several lines at once, wrap them in a single block comment instead of adding `//` to every line:
```swift
var total = 100
/*
total = total - 30
total = total - 20
*/
print(total) // prints 100
```
Thanks to nesting, this works even when one of those lines already contains a `/* */` comment.

# --instructions--

Comment out the two lines that change `total` with a single block comment, so that `total` stays `100`. Keep the inner `/* base */` comment as it is

# --before-seed--

# --seed--

```swift
var total = 100
total = total /* base */ - 30
total = total - 20
```

# --asserts--

The two lines must be wrapped in a block comment that still contains `/* base */`

```json
{
  "regex": "/\\*[\\s\\S]*total = total /\\* base \\*/ - 30[\\s\\S]*total = total - 20[\\s\\S]*\\*/",
  "modifiers": ["m"],
  "shouldMatch": true
}
```

`total` must be equal to `100`

```swift
tryCatch(total == 100)
```
